chain_words.nuance: a mischievous act meant to surprise someone
a deliberate act meant to deceive or fool someone
a cunning plan used to mislead an opponent
a serious and sustained effort to make someone believe something false

explanation: These words all describe an act meant to fool someone, with increasing seriousness from a light joke to a sustained deception.

usage_notes.difference: 'Prank' is usually playful and short-lived, while 'trick' can be more deliberate and may aim to gain an advantage.
